reference: GNU coreutils nice, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell and LC_ALL=C; status (recorded on stdout) and stderr bytes of option errors are compared.
coverage: Pass 8 (G120): option errors in GNU form, naming the command only, with the GNU status.

cases.purpose: G120: an unknown long option is reported as nice reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.
G120: an unknown short option is reported as nice reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.

cases.script:
rc=0
nice -n || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
nice --adjustment || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G120: an adjustment needs a command.
